title: Princess Y85
highlights: Flybridge with wet bar and Opacmare davit
description:
This 2021 Princess Y85 offers a four-stateroom, five-head layout and has been upgraded with twin Kohler 32 kW generators, an upgraded Garmin navigation package, Yacht Controller wireless docking and Starlink Gen 6 installed in March 2026.

Zero-speed fin stabilisers keep her steady underway and at anchor, and the spacious flybridge features a wet bar, an Opacmare davit and a GRP hardtop with electric opening louvres. Tax paid, she is lying in Jupiter, Florida.
